streaming_a_prototype.note: Temporary prototype only; no repository implementation changed. Alternating order; one warm pair discarded, five measured pairs. Not a production-wide equivalence proof.

protocol.stack: 6 x 999 x 750 BGR uint8 real demo images
protocol.isolation: Fresh subprocess per condition; sequential conditions; three repetitions inside each subprocess
protocol.timing: perf_counter; excludes imports, image decoding, output hashing; first run reported separately; warm statistic median of remaining two runs
protocol.memory: process RSS sampled every 10 ms from Win32 APIs; includes interpreter/libraries/input; lifetime peak also recorded; no sampling guarantee for shorter allocations
protocol.registration_parameters: ImageRegistration(method=...), other constructor defaults, no disk cache
limits: One desktop, one small 8-bit real stack; not representative of deep/16-bit/12-24MP stacks
Only two warm observations per condition; visible time variability; no claims of new implementation speedup
QCoreApplication timer is not a visible GUI or other applications responsiveness test
Output comparisons use quantized uint8; do not prove 16-bit or unquantized-float equivalence

implementation_outcome.method: Fresh subprocess per condition, alternating base commit (4659b7b) and the branch, 4 runs each, median of the warm runs; the same demo stack and parameters as the baseline table above.
implementation_outcome.scope: Historical pre-review implementation timings; not remeasured after the resource-policy correctness review.

results.note: Interleaved old/new measurement on an idle machine; an earlier concurrent run reported 0.52x, which was load pollution. The DTCWT change is the vote-map stream plus the thread cap.

limits: One 6-frame 999x750 8-bit stack on one CPU-only machine.
Small stacks spend their time in per-call overhead, so the large wins here (openfocus_c, stackmffv3) are the ones with real per-frame or per-tile allocations removed.
No GPU was available: CUDA/MPS paths are implemented but not measured.
Peak RSS is dominated by the interpreter and the source stack on this input size; the memory win is in live full-stack temporaries, which this metric does not isolate.

pixel_cases.input: six uint16 crops with independently populated low bits
